site_v2.exactness_claim: Output byte-identical to serial decoding at TP=3 on its own 8-prompt greedy check, with speculative decoding on
site_v2.comparison_claim: Code and structured are above the reference line on every repeat; prose is below.

comparison.engine_weights: TensorFold uses Vontra's MLX affine weights; the published reference uses NVIDIA's NVFP4 checkpoint. The engines and weight formats differ.
comparison.topology: This recipe uses Sparks cabled as a triangle.

limitations: No swapcheck receipt for this configuration.
A complete clean-room install on fresh hardware is still pending.
Use only documented draft-policy values; the parser accepts some invalid values.
Weights outside the mounted data directory cannot be used by the split script.
The test of the unquantized drafter does not establish that it drafted.
An identical resend misses the prompt cache and pays full prefill again; an appended turn reuses cached prompt tokens.
